Shanghai Municipal Council.
C. I. D.
F. O. REG
No. 150
Date 8/3/26
March 4th 19/6

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL COUNCIL POLICE FORCE）
POLICE FORCE,
(DETECTIVE BRANCH)

Sir,
A code telegram was received yesterday by General Tang
from Chiangchun Feng Kou Chang 馮國璋 telling him to take
great precautions as the situation in Nanking was very serious,
the people of the City having become alarmed by the presence
of 20,000 Northern troops who arrived at Pukow three days ago.
A second telegram was received by General Yang from the same
source on the same day informing him that the troops of
Hupeh are pro-rebel, and that that province is expected to
declare its independence within a few days.
With reference to yesterday's report regarding the
arrest of two men in the vicinity of the Arsenal, it now
transpires that their names are Khong Tse Hyuin 孔在興 and
Wong Hai Ching 王海清. They came to this country from
Tokio some weeks ago and had just arrived from Hangchow
at the time of their arrest. They say they came here
on the instructions of a rebel leader named Dan Zung Foong
（批：丹zung foong） on a certain mission, which they decline to disclose.

Your Obedient Servant,

（签名）

Chief Detective Inspector.

Captain Superintendent of Police.

转交上海义勇队（S.V.C.）指挥官知悉。
（批注：供分局）供中央特别警察处（C.S.P.）参考。
上海公共租界工部局。
刑事侦缉处。
外侨登记处
第 150 号
日期 26年3月8日
19/6年3月4日

（印章：上海公共租界工部局警务处）
警务处，
（侦探分部）

先生：

唐将军昨日收到冯国璋（Chiangchun Feng Kou Chang）发来的密电，告知他务必严加防范，因南京局势十分严峻，市民因三天前有两万北军抵达浦口而人心惶惶。杨将军同日从同一来源收到第二封电报，获悉湖北军队倾向叛军，预计该省将在数日内宣布独立。

关于昨日报告中提及在兵工厂附近逮捕两名男子一事，现查明其姓名为孔在興（Khong Tse Hyuin）和王海清（Wong Hai Ching）。他们数周前从东京来到本国，被捕时刚从杭州抵达。他们称是奉一名名为丹zung foong（批注：丹zung foong）的叛军首领之命前来执行某项任务，但拒绝透露具体任务内容。

此致
敬礼

（签名）

总探长

警务处警司
